channel.title: The 19th News – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The 19th News – Bias and Credibility (19thnews.org)

item.title: The women leading the farmworker movement won’t let it be defined by Cesar Chavez
item.description: The sexual abuse allegations against Chavez have rocked them. But their focus is still on protecting other women.

item.title: Her colleague released an Islamophobic campaign ad. Now this Georgia lawmaker is running against him.
item.description: Nabilah Parkes hopes to become the state's first Muslim lieutenant governor — despite a rise in Islamophobic rhetoric from prominent Republicans.

item.title: How the term ‘neurodivergent’ moved from activists to pop culture — and politics
item.description: Nicki Minaj is one of the most recent Trump supporters to identify herself as “neurodivergent,” embracing a narrow definition of a once-niche term commonly associated with autism and ADHD.

item.title: She followed a civil rights hero to Alabama. It shaped her path to power.
item.description: Jocelyn Benson’s journey to the Michigan governor’s race began with Viola Liuzzo, a mother from Detroit who set out for Selma in March of 1965 to join the fight for voting rights.

item.title: Some endometriosis patients are changing their diets to manage symptoms
item.description: Endometriosis is underresearched and underdiagnosed. Providers and patients alike are trying a more holistic approach — but does it work?

item.title: A composer brings music, joy and trans visibility to her church
item.description: While religion has been used for decades to ostracize many transgender people, Rachel Burckardt has found that her faith drives acceptance in her community.

item.title: How redefining birthright citizenship could impact children of immigrants
item.description: Justices are hearing arguments in a case challenging President Trump’s executive order brought by pregnant people who fear their children will be “stateless.”

item.title: Supreme Court says Colorado can’t ban conversion therapy for LGBTQ+ youth
item.description: The case was brought by a Christian counselor who argued that Colorado’s ban violated her free speech rights.

item.title: Trapped and alone: Fear of ICE is deepening postpartum isolation for immigrant mothers
item.description: Doctors say newly postpartum people need medical care, sleep and the ability to rely on friends and family for help. Immigration crackdowns have made that support impossible.

item.title: Who gets to lead the church? Women and LGBTQ+ pastors are forcing an answer.
item.description: Photographer Corrie Aune captured the personal walks of faith that led women and LGBTQ+ pastors to claim the pulpit.

item.title: Supreme Court appears skeptical over Trump’s push to restrict citizenship at birth
item.description: The high court heard oral arguments on Wednesday in a landmark case that will determine whether President Donald Trump can essentially redefine who is considered an American.

item.title: We're hiring a contract climate reporter
item.description: The 19th is seeking a full-time contract reporter to report, write and produce climate coverage, focusing on how politics and policies impact women and LGBTQ+ people.

item.title: The push to include religion in classrooms could shape how schools treat gender and identity
item.description: Prayer mandates and Ten Commandments laws are part of an effort experts worry will marginalize students based on gender, sexual orientation and race.

item.title: Pam Bondi out as attorney general
item.description: Bondi, the second Cabinet member to be ousted by President Trump, faced widespread criticism over the DOJ’s handling of the Epstein files.

item.title: Gender-affirming care is becoming a political test for top medical groups
item.description: The country’s largest organization representing doctors is being pressed by Republican attorneys general on health care for trans youth.
